entries.title: No commit or deployment references an unapproved or deprecated model hash
Every deployed checkpoint carries a verified signature whose root digest recomputes from its resource digests
Model weights are serialised in a format that cannot execute code on load
The served artifact's hash matches the registry entry it claims to be
Merged models declare every base model in their lineage
Training, fine-tuning and evaluation relationships are declared on the checkpoint record
A system prompt carries an immutable version identity, distinct from its deployment label
Moving a production prompt label is reviewed by a named owner
Every release publishes a model bill of materials bound to the artifact digest
Training data of prohibited provenance is never ingested
An unrecognised licence string fails closed rather than defaulting to permissive
Machine-readable text-and-data-mining opt-out signals are checked at crawl time and honoured
Content is not acquired by bypassing a clickthrough or paywall
A noncommercial-licensed corpus is never used in a commercial training run
Share-alike obligations are evaluated before a corpus is mixed into a proprietary release
Conflicting licence claims on a dataset are resolved before ingestion, not after
Every new corpus carries machine-readable provenance metadata
A model trained on unsanitised personal data is never deployed to production
Prompt templates and training shards pass a personal-data scan before use
Special-category data is excluded, or its basis is recorded
A lawful basis is recorded for every personal-data source
Prompt and completion logs are redacted before retention
A data protection impact assessment is attached where processing is high risk
De-identification is verified by sampling, not asserted
Agentic code modifying core system logic requires recorded human sign-off
Agents never modify security policies, compliance guardrails or CI/CD configuration
Every agentic commit carries a verifiable cryptographic signature bound to the agent identity
Every newly imported package is verified to exist in the upstream registry before compilation
Agent-authored code executes only inside a sandboxed runner
Agent code calls only allowlisted external hosts
Agent changes are labelled and isolated so they can be reviewed independently
Agent instructions derived from untrusted text are treated as tainted input
Model output never reaches a downstream execution sink without validation
System prompts and weight-adjacent secrets are not extractable through model output
The instruction/data boundary is enforced on every retrieval path
The carrier channel of untrusted input is declared and handled per channel
Fine-tuning data distribution stays within its variance threshold, and the pipeline halts if not
New training shards are screened for backdoor triggers
Inference endpoints keep their rate limits and output perturbation
Membership-inference advantage stays below its threshold
Verbatim training-data emission stays below the declared span threshold
Canary tokens are absent from model output
Injection detection is exercised on every changed retrieval or tool path
No training or fine-tuning run ingests evaluation or benchmark data
A failing safety evaluation is never disabled, weakened or excluded to obtain a passing build
A commit altering the inference engine meets its semantic-parity threshold against the pinned baseline
A parity claim declares its sample size and its percentile
Accuracy passing does not by itself establish that the optimisation under test is still engaged
Judge–human agreement is measured for the judge configuration in use
An objective checker is preferred over a model judge wherever one exists
Golden-prompt baselines are pinned to a commit and never rewritten to match an output
Every new corpus is run through a decontamination check against the eval suites
No deployment above a declared capability threshold without a completed and signed safety case
Model weights are never reachable outside the declared control boundary
Granting access to unreleased weights requires two-person authorisation
A capability evaluation is completed for every checkpoint proposed for deployment
The mitigation level applied matches the assessed capability level
A safety case is not signed by the team that authored it
Safety incidents are reported within the statutory deadline
Signing keys for release artifacts are backed by a hardware module
Time to first token stays within its declared budget for the serving tier
Time per output token stays within its declared budget for the serving tier
A change causing more than five percent latency degradation is rejected
KV-cache growth is bounded and its budget explicitly pinned
High-concurrency profiling shows no tensor allocation leak after warm-up
A latency claim declares its arrival distribution and its percentile
A bitwise-replay claim holds only under declared batch invariance, hardware and engine version
A newly introduced nondeterministic operation is declared and registered
Every agentic workflow enforces a numerically declared loop limit and a cost circuit breaker that cannot be disabled
A loop limit declares its units, not just its value
A loop limit is not overridable by an environment variable
Cost control is a pre-flight breaker, not a meter read after the fact
Agent quotas are bound to the agent identity and its cost centre
Recursive tool-call paths carry a terminator
A response the toxicity filter flags never propagates to a caller
Refusal behaviour is correct on harmful prompts
Over-refusal on safe prompts stays below its threshold
Demographic disparity stays below its threshold
An ambiguous context is answered as unknown rather than guessed
Persona and tone guidance holds in the release build
Generated code structurally identical to a restricted copyleft library never merges
Licence detection runs on every agent-authored file
Attribution obligations survive to the release artifact
A memorisation probe runs on every release candidate
Verbatim reproduction of third-party text stays below its threshold
The third-party licence inventory is updated with every dependency change
No artifact deploys without provenance verified against the expected builder identity
Builds are hermetic and reproducible in ephemeral isolated environments
The provenance subject digest matches the artifact actually distributed
Dependencies are pinned to an immutable digest and resolve from the internal registry first
No dependency is introduced carrying a known vulnerability above the CVSS threshold
Every release publishes a signed SBOM covering transitive dependencies
Workflow actions are pinned to a commit digest
No secret material appears in a diff
All new database access uses parameterised queries
Deserialisation is restricted to known types
Every new endpoint enforces server-side authorization
Tool integrations cannot be steered into internal network addresses
Error responses omit internal identifiers and stack traces
Changed endpoints are fuzzed before release
Human oversight override for a high-risk feature is never removed by configuration
Practices prohibited under EU AI Act Article 5 are never implemented in a product surface
Decision and audit records are append-only
The compute-threshold determination is recorded per jurisdiction and never conflates them
The constitution declares whether any party holds contest standing adverse to grants
Constitutional parameters change only by legislative enactment
Reporter output never reaches the adjudication input path, and the audit register is never read by resolve
Every arrival that is not charged leaves exactly one docket entry
High-risk systems maintain a risk management system across the lifecycle
High-risk systems meet the data-governance requirements for training, validation and testing sets
High-risk systems meet the accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity requirements
Governance practices follow the NIST Generative AI Profile's suggested actions
Release records cite the frontier safety framework version in force
Child sexual abuse material detection on uploads, generations and model outputs, and the CyberTipline report and preservation path, are never disabled, sampled down or made configurable
Every training-ingest path runs known-abuse-material hash matching before a shard is stored, and a matched shard is quarantined and never enters a corpus
Age-assurance signals and minor-interaction safeguards on consumer surfaces are enforced server-side and are not removed or made bypassable by a client

Personal information from users known to be under thirteen, or from child-directed services, is excluded from training and fine-tuning corpora unless verifiable parental consent covering that use is recorded
No model assessed at or above the biological or chemical uplift threshold is deployed, internally or externally, until the full mitigation package for that level is applied and verified
A cyber-offence uplift evaluation on the declared task protocol gates every promotion, and its result is attested rather than self-reported
An autonomous-replication and self-exfiltration evaluation is completed for every agentic checkpoint before release, with the sandbox probes that detect it left active
The evaluation harness carries sandbagging and evaluation-awareness detection, and every uplift result declares the elicitation effort behind it
Egress monitoring and data-loss prevention on weight stores and training clusters are never disabled, downgraded to advisory or widened to arbitrary destinations
Access to unreleased weights is bound to a current personnel-vetting record and is revoked automatically on role change or vetting expiry
An export-classification determination is recorded before model weights or training technology are transferred outside the declared boundary or released to a foreign national

Denied-party and sanctioned-destination screening on account enablement, enterprise counterparties and weight-transfer recipients is never bypassed, allow-by-default or auto-cleared without a reviewer
Machine-readable synthetic-content marking on every generative output modality is never removed, made opt-out per tenant or stripped by a downstream stage the provider controls
General-purpose model technical documentation, downstream-provider information and the public training-content summary are current at release, not carried over from the previous one
The frontier transparency report is published at or before deployment, and the anonymous internal safety-concern channel is preserved with its anti-retaliation notice
Critical safety incident detection signals reach the reporting queue, and the statutory reporting clock is fixed in code, never configurable, extended or avoided by severity defaults
The crisis and self-harm safety classifier and its crisis-resource handoff are never weakened, bypassed for streaming or removed from a consumer response path
Political-persuasion and election-influence policy checks run for every tenant, and the election-integrity classifier stays in the release gate through an electoral cycle
High-stakes medical, legal and financial responses keep their qualified-professional handoff and their automated-assistant disclosure in every served persona
Companion-mode safeguards for accounts flagged as minors — periodic break reminders, sexual-content blocking and an explicit non-human disclosure — are enforced and not persona-configurable
The usage-policy enforcement and abuse-monitoring pipeline runs at its declared sample rate on every tier, and non-consensual intimate imagery removal completes within the statutory clock
Erasure and unlearning requests propagate to training manifests, derived corpora and the next-run exclusion list, and complete within the statutory window
Zero-data-retention commitments are enforced in the retention code path itself, with no debug capture and no service-level override flag
Prefix and key-value caches, fine-tune adapters and retrieval indexes are partitioned per tenant and never shared, loadable or queryable across a tenant boundary
Annotator and data-worker personal data is processed under a recorded basis, stripped from exported preference datasets, and the workers' graphic-content exposure limits stay enforced in the queue
Government and law-enforcement requests for user data pass legal review before disclosure, are logged append-only with their scope, and trigger customer notice where the law allows
Ship fast or test fully: ship with at most one open non-security checklist item, with a remediation ticket
Cost or quality: cost cuts may not remove a documented quality control
Customer first: customer-visible latency regressions need a stated customer benefit
Accessibility beyond law: never remove an existing accessibility feature without a token from the accessibility lead
House style for alternative text and messages
Documentation currency: docs updated with the change
